unnecessary_ports.reason: Transmits exam credentials and test files in unencrypted cleartext; high risk of exam paper leakage.
Windows RPC endpoint mapper susceptible to network enumeration by secondary devices in the exam venue.
Legacy NetBIOS Session Service prone to local candidate machine discovery and unauthorized session hijacking.
Direct file sharing port frequently targeted by network exploits or unauthorized peer-to-peer exam answer sharing.

details.mitigation: Replace plain FTP with secure SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) for exam question/answer uploads.

recommended_firewall_rules.windows_firewall_cmd: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Exam Security Block Port 21 (FTP)" dir=in action=block protocol=TCP localport=21
recommended_firewall_rules.linux_ufw_cmd: sudo ufw deny in proto tcp to any port 21 comment "Exam Security Block FTP"
recommended_firewall_rules.rationale: Block prohibited port 21 (FTP) on 10.24.96.60 to isolate the exam environment and prevent remote cheating/assistance.

security_improvements.finding: Detected unencrypted plain-text FTP traffic during exam session.
security_improvements.action_item: Replace plain FTP with secure SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) for exam question/answer uploads.

security_improvements.finding: Candidate examination workstation shares the subnet with unmonitored local network devices.
security_improvements.action_item: Isolate candidate exam devices onto a dedicated Exam VLAN with strict inter-VLAN firewall routing during testing.

security_improvements.finding: Static MAC identity checks are vulnerable to device impersonation via MAC address spoofing (Phase 3 audit).
security_improvements.action_item: Enforce 802.1X Port-Based Network Access Control (NAC) alongside candidate hardware MAC verification.
